COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) as car04_before_mileage_calc FROM car01_info INNER JOIN car04_journal ON car04_info_id = car01_info_id WHERE car01_company_id = #{companyId} AND car01_info_id = #{infoId} AND car01_car_type = '1' AND car04_date >= COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(car04_date) FROM car04_journal WHERE car04_company_id = car01_company_id AND car04_info_id = car01_info_id AND COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND car04_date < TO_DATE(#{stdMonth}||'.01','yyyy.mm.dd') ),'1999-01-01') ) t ) SELECT car04_journal_id AS journal_id , car04_company_id AS company_id , car04_info_id AS info_id , car04_date AS "date" , car04_person_id AS person_id , car04_mileage AS mileage , CASE WHEN COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN car04_before_mileage ELSE car04_before_mileage_calc2 END AS before_mileage , CASE WHEN COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN car04_after_mileage ELSE car04_before_mileage_calc2 + COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) END AS after_mileage , car04_commute_mileage AS commute_mileage , car04_biz_mileage AS biz_mileage , car04_un_biz_mileage AS un_biz_mileage , car04_destination AS destination , car04_reason AS reason , car04_note AS note , car04_booking_id AS booking_id , (COALESCE(car04_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS fix_yn , (COALESCE(car04_close_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS close_yn , COALESCE(car04_commute_mileage, 0) + COALESCE(car04_biz_mileage, 0) AS business_mileage , car01_car_no||' - SELECT , car04_before_mileage AS before_mileage, car04_after_mileage AS after_mileage, NULL AS info_nm, NULL AS info_person_nm FROM car04_journal WHERE car04_company_id = #{companyId} AND car04_journal_id = #{journalId}

COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) as car04_before_mileage_calc FROM car01_info INNER JOIN car04_journal ON car04_info_id = car01_info_id WHERE car01_company_id = #{companyId} AND car01_info_id = #{infoId} AND car01_car_type = '1' --(1:전용차량) AND car04_date >= COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(car04_date) FROM car04_journal WHERE car04_company_id = car01_company_id AND car04_info_id = car01_info_id AND COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND car04_date < TO_DATE(#{stdMonth}||'.01','yyyy.mm.dd') ),'1999-01-01') UNION SELECT car01_info.* , COALESCE(car04_journal_id , car03_booking_id ) AS car04_journal_id , COALESCE(car04_company_id , car01_company_id ) AS car04_company_id , COALESCE(car04_info_id , car03_info_id ) AS car04_info_id , COALESCE(car04_date , car03_start_date ) AS car04_date , car04_person_id AS car04_person_id , car04_mileage AS car04_mileage , car04_before_mileage AS car04_before_mileage , car04_after_mileage AS car04_after_mileage , car04_commute_mileage AS car04_commute_mileage , car04_biz_mileage AS car04_biz_mileage , car04_un_biz_mileage AS car04_un_biz_mileage , COALESCE(car04_destination , car03_destination ) AS car04_destination , COALESCE(car04_reason , car03_reason ) AS car04_reason , COALESCE(car04_note , car03_note ) AS car04_note , COALESCE(car04_booking_id , car03_booking_id ) AS car04_booking_id , COALESCE(car04_fix_yn , 'false' ) AS car04_fix_yn , COALESCE(car04_close_yn , 'false' ) AS car04_close_yn , car03_attendance AS car04_attendance , car03_start_hour||car03_start_min AS car04_seq , CASE WHEN car04_close_yn = 'true' THEN car04_after_mileage ELSE SUM(COALESCE(car04_mileage,0)) OVER (ORDER BY car04_date, car03_start_hour, car03_start_min) END - COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) AS car04_before_mileage_calc FROM car01_info INNER JOIN car03_booking ON car03_info_id = car01_info_id LEFT OUTER JOIN car04_journal ON car04_booking_id = car03_booking_id WHERE car01_company_id = #{companyId} AND car01_info_id = #{infoId} AND car04_date >= COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(car04_date) FROM car04_journal WHERE car04_company_id = car01_company_id AND car04_info_id = car01_info_id AND COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND car04_date < TO_DATE(#{stdMonth}||'.01','yyyy.mm.dd') ),'1999-01-01') AND car01_car_type = '2' --(2:공용차량) ) t inner join sys01_company on sys01_company_id = car04_company_id ) SELECT journal.car04_journal_id AS journal_id, journal.car04_company_id AS company_id, journal.car04_info_id AS info_id, journal.car04_date AS "date", journal.car04_person_id AS person_id, journal.car04_mileage AS mileage, CASE WHEN COALESCE(journal.car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN journal.car04_before_mileage ELSE journal.car04_before_mileage_calc2 END AS before_mileage, CASE WHEN COALESCE(journal.car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN journal.car04_after_mileage ELSE journal.car04_before_mileage_calc2 + COALESCE(journal.car04_mileage,0) END AS after_mileage, journal.car04_commute_mileage AS commute_mileage, journal.car04_biz_mileage AS biz_mileage, journal.car04_un_biz_mileage AS un_biz_mileage, journal.car04_destination AS destination, journal.car04_reason AS reason, journal.car04_note AS note, journal.car04_booking_id AS booking_id, (COALESCE(journal.car04_fix_yn,'false') = 'true') AS fix_yn, (COALESCE(journal.car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true') AS close_yn, COALESCE(journal.car04_commute_mileage, 0) + COALESCE(journal.car04_biz_mileage, 0) AS business_mileage, journal.car01_car_no||' - '||journal.car01_car_nm AS info_nm, ( CASE WHEN journal.car01_car_type = '1' THEN ( SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(car02_person_id) FROM car02_user WHERE car02_info_id = journal.car01_info_id AND car02_start_date <= car04_date ORDER BY car02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(journal.car04_person_id) END) AS info_person_nm FROM ( SELECT car.* , car04_before_mileage_calc + ( SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN car01_init_mileage ELSE 0 END FROM car WHERE seq = 1 ) AS car04_before_mileage_calc2 FROM car ) journal WHERE to_char(journal.car04_date,'YYYY.MM') = #{stdMonth} ORDER BY journal.seq
